verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents a built-in AI assistant ('Accounting AI', 'AI Close Agents') that users delegate accounting tasks to — importing PDFs/CSVs, categorizing transactions, closing books, and answering natural-language business questions ('How's my cash trending?') — with human review before finalizing. This matches the delegation story well, though evidence is entirely first-party docs/marketing with no independent hands-on report of the assistant's actual task-delegation behavior. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of the AI assistant's real-world reliability and scope of delegable tasks.
